codex-quick-connect.title: Connect local Codex
codex-quick-connect.intro: Detect a native installation, configure its provider and read the actual model catalogue, then connect an execution node to this project.
codex-quick-connect.desktop_required: Use the desktop app to detect local Codex. In a browser, connect a configured server Runner with a reported inventory.
codex-quick-connect.credential_hint: Enter only a local environment variable reference, never a secret. The draft is not yet applied to the current connection.
codex-quick-connect.choose_sandbox: Explicitly select an implementation supported by this installation
codex-quick-connect.catalogue_ready: {{value}} models observed. The connection basis is still valid.
codex-quick-connect.catalogue_expired: The original catalogue contains {{value}} models. It cannot currently authorize a new connection.
codex-quick-connect.selection_later: Choose the model and reasoning effort when dispatching a task. Reading the catalogue does not prove a model call succeeded.
codex-quick-connect.draft_not_connected: The draft differs from the active connection and has not replaced its configuration.
codex-quick-connect.local_record_unavail: The original operation record cannot be saved or verified. Preserve the current information and retry reconciliation.
codex-quick-connect.draft_not_saved: The draft could not be saved safely. Check its fields and local storage. Do not put credentials, query parameters or fragments in the URL.
codex-quick-connect.invalid_observation: The observation does not match the current account, project or original operation.
codex-quick-connect.read_failed: The current observation could not be confirmed. Check the original operation.
